title: Bailiff Vance's farewell line ('Mind the steps on your way out...') is unchanged immediately after his preferred, Crown-favoring outcome lost in The Tithe Question (granary made a common store, Crown standing -2), unlike every other Hearthlands NPC tied to that grief (Sergeant Rook, Sela, Sister Winnow, Lay-brother Emmet, Peg), who all got a new 'now it's rested' line.
